# clauses-v-one-result-per-class [replication] proofs/Clauses.v (537 lines, 74 Theorems, 74 Qed, 74 Print Assumptions) generated by side_block() in tools/render_coverings.py
LOC 305 -> 50

## description
Every one of the 74 theorems in the generated Clauses.v had one of exactly TWO statements, byte-identical across all 37 effect sides apart from the theorem's name: `forall Delta E d, name_agnostic string (effect string E d)` and `forall Delta E d d', E d -> ~E d' -> forall segs, effect string E d segs /\ ~effect string E d' segs`. Neither mentions the side. So 72 of the 74 were copies of the other two, each paying its own Qed and its own Print Assumptions. What IS per-side is which sides belong to the class -- so the render now emits, per class, one `Inductive <Class>Side` whose constructors are the sides, and ONE result quantified over it. The per-side census moves from `prf` names to `constr` entries of coqc's own index (the same index, not the comments -- check_coq's docstring records that a comment-counting grader once passed 54 lines of comments, and eval/attacks.sh coq_comments_only still re-plants that attack: verified still RED). A new guard was added so the enumeration cannot become decoration: any `ind` the file declares that no result references (`ref`, read from the glob's R lines) is refused -- verified by replacing the theorem with `Theorem ... : True` (FAIL 'enumerates sides in [EffectSide] and no result quantifies over it') and by deleting one constructor (FAIL 'side U25_discharged_by (class effect) is in no enumeration'). The gate's own census output is unchanged: sides=51, instantiated=36, empty-by-class[always=7 tool-enum=8].
